1. By filing the present suit, the plaintiff has sought decree of permanent injunction in  his favour and against the defendant thereby restraining the defendant, its  representatives, assignees, agents, attorneys, associates, nominees etc from interfering in  lawful possession of the plaintiff in shop no. 3, Sarojani Nagar Market, New Delhi110023.

2. The brief facts of the present case from the perspective of plaintiff as  discernible from the plaint and the documents of the plaintiff are that the plaintiff is running a  momos stall at shop no.3, Sarojani Nagar Market since 2010 and he has paid the renewal fees to  the defendant.
It is further stated that the plaintiff was also challaned by the  defendant under Delhi Municipal, which was fined by ld. Magistrate concerned.

3. It is the case of the plaintiff that the plaintiff had applied for his registration under Food Safety  and Standards Act, 2006 vide his application dated 07.6.2017 and  submitted all the relevant documents to department of Food Safety and thereafter, he was  registered under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 vide registration no. 23317009000142  dated 15.06.2017.
It is further the case of the plaintiff that the plaintiff was continuously  harassed by the officials of the defendant and had demanded illegal money from the plaintiff.

Further, they also threatened the plaintiff to be thrown out of his stall in case the plaintiff  would not pay the substantial amount on monthly basis.

8.

After the closing of exparte evidence of plaintiff, exparte final arguments  have been heard from Ms. Tabassum, ld. counsel for the plaintiff on 25.07.2018.
9.

It has been argued by ld. counsel for the plaintiff that the plaintiff has  successfully proved his case against the defendant by examining himself as PW1 and relying  upon documents Ex.PW1/1 (OSR) to Ex.PW1/20 (OSR), Ex.PW1/22 (OSR), Mark A and  Mark B Ex.PW1/G whereby it has been proved that the plaintiff is running the momos stall at  Shop no.3 Sarojani Nagar Market, New Delhi since prior to 2010.
10. I have considered the entire evidence led by the plaintiff in support of his case.

From a  perusal of the testimony of the plaintiff as well as from a perusal of the  documents of the plaintiff, it is evident that the plaintiff is in settled possession of the suit  property and is duly registered under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
It is also proved  by the plaintiff that he has been regularly paying the renewal license fee.
The testimony of the  sole witness of plaintiff
has remained unrebutted and unchallenged.

Therefore, the  plaintiff has been able to prove that plaintiff is entitled to permanent injunction in his favour  and against the defendant. 
11.

It is, therefore, ordered that the defendant is permanently restrained from  interfering or from dispossessing the plaintiff from shop no. 3, Sarojani Nagar Market, New Delhi  110023 without following due process of law.
The suit is decreed in favour of the plaintiff and  against the defendant on the above terms.
Decree sheet be prepared  accordingly.
File be consigned to record room after compliance of necessary formalities.
